inputs.name: recordResponse.report
inputs.description: The response-check result passed to analytics recording. The recorder records status, requested model, an optional evaluator model, a fingerprint of input hashes and rubric settings, and usage token counts; it omits checks, coverage, mode, and error text.

inputs.name: recordResponse.context
inputs.description: Optional loop, loop-run, step, task, agent-model, and report associations copied onto the event. This workflow passes the context through without resolving defaults or validating it.

inputs.name: recordResponse.durationMs
inputs.description: Elapsed response-check duration in milliseconds, copied unchanged into the analytics event. No range is enforced here.

inputs.name: recordCleanCode.report
inputs.description: The clean-code result passed to analytics recording. The event includes status, requested model, distinct file evaluator models when present, an all-files cached flag, a fingerprint of file paths and hashes plus rubric settings, and usage token counts; it omits coverage and assessments.

inputs.name: recordCleanCode.context
inputs.description: Optional loop, loop-run, step, task, agent-model, and report associations copied onto the event. This workflow passes the context through without resolving defaults or validating it.

inputs.name: recordCleanCode.timing
inputs.description: Project root used by analytics recording to identify the repository, plus clean-code elapsed duration in milliseconds. The root is passed to project identity lookup and the duration is copied without a range check.

outputs.name: recordResponse
outputs.description: Promise<void> that resolves after the response analytics record is attempted; it yields no JSON value or event ID. Analytics persistence is skipped when HARNESS_ANALYTICS_DISABLED is set to 1, and recordAnalytics catches its persistence failures.

outputs.name: recordCleanCode
outputs.description: Promise<void> that resolves after the clean-code analytics record is attempted; it yields no JSON value or event ID. Analytics persistence is skipped when HARNESS_ANALYTICS_DISABLED is set to 1, and recordAnalytics catches its persistence failures.
